title: Styling in React
description: Learn different approaches to styling React components.
longDescription: React doesn't enforce a single styling approach. This module surveys four major strategies: CSS Modules for scoped class names, styled-components for dynamic CSS-in-JS, Tailwind CSS for utility-first rapid development, and inline styles for dynamic one-off values.
whatYouLearn: Scope styles to individual components using CSS Modules
Write dynamic, theme-aware styles with styled-components
Build responsive layouts quickly using Tailwind utility classes
Apply inline styles for dynamic values and know their limitations
